title: nan
authors: Fares H.; Mohanna A.; Kaddouh B.
key_contribution: Presents REOLA, a real-time elevation and orientation-aware visual localization architecture for GNSS-denied drone navigation using satellite imagery, deep learning, and RLHF, with real-time embedded deployment.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
